failureReason: UI Run failed: 'engine access denied: malformed'. Root cause isolated: addonEngineBinding forwards the caller's 3-part gateway JWT to the engine, but signed engine access requires a 2-part engine-access token (packages/gateway/src/deploy/engineAccess.ts verify requires exactly 2 parts). Diagnostic (non-UI): direct POST :8107/run for the same document/grant presenting this session's valid engine-access token returned 200 {sum:58,count:5} - add-on, grant and binding all work when a valid engine token is presented. Same 'malformed' error is visible in the ORIGINAL case-11 screenshot 08-after-run.png, so this residual predates the binding fix and is independent of it.
